svg.text: Black ESP32-C3 SuperMini · component side up · USB pointing down

g.text: Button uses the internal pull-up, no resistor needed. Do not power from USB and batteries at the same time.
Avoid GPIO 2, 8 and 9 for the button (boot strapping pins).

svg.text: Purple ESP32-C3 with 0.42" OLED · component side up · USB pointing down

g.text: Nothing to wire for the PoC — USB only.
Status LED is on-board (GPIO8). OLED is on-board (GPIO5/6).
Pins 5 and 6 are used by the OLED: don't wire anything to them.
Board has diodes in the power path: not suitable for battery use.
